story: Ben wanted to eat the bread, but a puppy shivered on a high ledge. Ben said, “The puppy needs help.” Mum said, “I can lower the basket.” Ben said, “I can share the bread.” Ben put the bread in the basket. Mum carried the basket to the window, and she lowered the basket to the ledge with the rope. Ben waited because the puppy was frightened. The puppy entered the basket, and it ate the bread. Mum lowered the basket to the garden with the rope. Ben carried the puppy into the cottage, and he wrapped the puppy in the warm blanket. Ben was hungry, but the puppy rested in the warm blanket.

Mum carries the basket to the window, and she lowers the basket to the ledge with the rope. Ben waits because the puppy is frightened. The puppy enters the basket, and it eats the bread. Mum lowers the basket to the garden with the rope. Ben carries the puppy into the cottage, and he wraps the puppy in the warm blanket. Ben is hungry, but the puppy rests in the warm blanket.

Mum carries the basket to the window, and she lowers the basket to the ledge with the rope. Sam waits because the puppy is frightened. The puppy enters the basket, and it eats the bread. Mum lowers the basket to the garden with the rope. Sam carries the puppy into the cottage, and he wraps the puppy in the warm blanket. Sam is hungry, but the puppy rests in the warm blanket.
